scope: Full graph; constant descending input; no gait tracker, direct motor stimulus, force assist or training.

physiology.normalization: Explicit reference volume supplied by experiment; no graph selection change. Missing volumes use the normalizer.
physiology.scope: Unvalidated full-CNS extension; source study uses different graph selections and an adaptive solver.

metrics.interpretation: Displacement and contact transitions alone cannot distinguish stepping from sliding or tipping.
